item.title: I survived a missile strike in the Strait of Hormuz, but my friend has not been found
item.description: Sunil Puniya was on his first sea job when a missile struck the oil tanker Skylight at the start of the Iran war.

item.title: Gaza flotilla activists allege abuse by Israeli forces while detained
item.description: The detainees say they were slapped, hit, humiliated and even subjected to sexual violence, but Israel's prison service says the allegations are false.

item.title: Rubio meets Modi during India visit with energy high on agenda
item.description: The secretary of state wants to sell US energy to Delhi to make up for shortfalls caused by the Iran war.

item.title: Trump says Iran deal 'largely negotiated' including reopening Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Tehran also signals progress on talks but says the key issue of nuclear weapons is not part of an initial framework it is working on.

item.title: SpaceX launches massive Starship V3 rocket on test flight
item.description: The largest and most powerful rocket in history blasted off after its first attempted launch was postponed.

item.title: California declares state of emergency as fire crews race to contain toxic chemical leak
item.description: Thousands have been evacuated as officials warn a tank containing about 7,000 gallons of methyl methacrylate could explode.

item.title: US government releases UFO sighting reports - 'Orbs swarming in all directions'
item.description: The Pentagon discloses scores of UFO files with reported sightings of spheres, discs and fireballs spanning nearly 80 years.
